name: Off By One Crash
essence: The label counter reaches the array length and dereferences the missing next item.

examples.summary: The label counter reaches the array length and dereferences the missing next item.
examples.mechanism: The inclusive loop condition and increment allow an out-of-bounds array read; JavaScript traps the subsequent property access rather than writing memory.
examples.observed_output: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'sku')

ingredients.suggests: The mutable counter advances after each item until it equals the array length.
The inclusive bound lets the consumer read sku from the missing slot at items.length.

examples.summary: An incremented loop counter is permitted to equal the list length, and indexing that position raises IndexError..
examples.mechanism: An incremented loop counter is permitted to equal the list length, and indexing that position raises IndexError.
examples.observed_output: IndexError: list index out of range

ingredients.suggests: The advancing counter reaches the array length under an inclusive bound.
The loop reads a slot beyond the last valid index.

examples.summary: The inclusive counter bound reaches a missing item and panics.
examples.mechanism: The inclusive counter bound reaches a missing item and panics.
examples.observed_output: panic: runtime error: index out of range [2] with length 2

ingredients.suggests: The mutable index increments until it reaches the array length.
The inclusive bound permits indexing the slot at len(items).

examples.summary: The loop indexes the slot just past the end.
examples.mechanism: The counter advances to the length while the inclusive loop condition still accepts it. The inclusive bound indexes the nonexistent element at the array length.
examples.observed_output: index out of bounds: the len is 2 but the index is 2

ingredients.suggests: The counter advances to the length while the inclusive loop condition still accepts it.
The inclusive bound indexes the nonexistent element at the array length.
